item.description: One row. Unknown fields are ignored. A bad item or action is dropped with a diagnostic instead of failing the feed.

actions.description: Commands run from the Feed overlay with the job's environment; the feed refreshes afterwards.

command.description: argv array; the first element is the program.

key.description: One visible character, unique per item. Reserved for the overlay: 'j' 'k' 'q' 'g' 'G' 'R' '/' and these key names: enter, return, esc, escape, up, down, left, right, tab, backtab, pageup, pagedown, home, end, backspace, delete, space.

title.description: Menu text; defaults to the key.

badge.description: Short tag such as a ticket key.

id.description: Unique within the feed (a repeated id keeps the first).

state.description: unread shows a dot and counts as unread; an unknown value becomes read.

title.description: Row text; defaults to the id.

url.description: Opened by enter or a click; http or https only.

description: What a job's feed command prints on stdout: ONE JSON object and nothing else, at most 4096 KiB. Longer strings are cut, items beyond 500 are dropped.

title.description: Section title; the job's feed.title wins.

version.description: A missing version is read as 1 with a diagnostic; any other value is rejected.

title: flockr feed v1
